title: Add view commands: graph, route, next, epic
description:
Priority view commands:
1. 'pebbles next' - Show actionable todo issues with no blockers (no required_for dependencies pointing to incomplete issues)
2. 'pebbles epic <id>' - List all issues that are part_of the specified epic

Lower priority: 'pebbles graph' (ASCII relationship diagram), 'pebbles route <from> <to>' (dependency path)
